compute_topk_accuracy: compute top-k classification accuracy for PyTorch model output predictions against target labels
create_average_meter: create an AverageMeter instance to track running average and current values of a metric
update_average_meter: update an AverageMeter with a new value and optional sample count for running average tracking
reset_average_meter: reset an AverageMeter to clear all accumulated values and start fresh tracking
use_average_meter_with_window: create an AverageMeter with a sliding window size to track recent metric averages
